title: Managed agents get an MCP registry, proxy, and transcription
summary:
A systems day: MCP agents gained transcription and discovery, Kontext returned to service, and generation accounting got much harder to confuse.

Managed agents can now discover registered MCP servers through a Pollinations-hosted registry and authenticated Gen proxy, starting with the existing Pollinations MCP. The MCP package also gained audio transcription from public HTTPS URLs, while the API docs now include a complete Endpoint Agent POST example. Agents have acquired ears and a more organized tool shed.

Azure Flux Kontext generation and single-reference editing now use Azure's supported Black Forest Labs route again. Its adapter also preserves useful upstream diagnostics, identifies content-policy blocks cleanly, and avoids declaring the model unhealthy because one request had a bad day.

Generation attempts across text, images, video, audio, embeddings, and 3D now share one ordered fallback trace, so the provider that actually completes a request gets the right attribution. API-key budgets reserve capacity atomically across HTTP, audio, proxy, and realtime routes, while empty upstream text streams return into the retry loop instead of masquerading as successful responses.
